title: Reproducible Data & Verification Suite for: Quantum Boltzmann Equation for Static Correlation with Cumulant Kernel Closure (Q-BESC & Q-BECK)
description:
Archival converged atomic-orbital 1-RDM datasets (.npz), numerical benchmark trajectories (.json and .npz), OpenAPI 3.1 gateway specification (openapi.json), and standalone PySCF / FastAPI verification suite (verify_reproducibility.py) accompanying the manuscript Quantum Boltzmann Equation for Static Correlation with Cumulant Kernel Closure by Romit Chakraborty (Point Reyes Sound, Inc.).

Covers all eight benchmark suites reported in the manuscript: collinear H3 exchange and Borland–Dennis generalized Pauli polytope distances, square H4 (D4h) Mott dissociation, BeH2 (C2v) Purvis–Bartlett avoided crossing, symmetric H2O double dissociation, N2 Dunning basis hierarchy and triple-bond cleavage, singlet ortho-, meta-, and para-benzyne diradicals, the 11-molecule MR-MGN-BE17 homolytic dissociation benchmark, and O(NAO3) computational scaling across NAO in [15, 300].
